items.title: Can Robinhood compete with banks after underwriting Oura's IPO?
items.summary: Great Hill Capital Chairman and Managing Member Thomas Hayes and AllSource Investment Management founder and Managing Partner Patrick Kennedy join Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss Robinhood (HOOD) serving as the underwriter for Oura ahead of its IPO and whether the platform is accumulating a reputation as a bank.

items.title: Robinhood Lands Crypto.com Deal, Underwriting Job For Oura. Goldman Hikes Target.
items.summary: Robinhood takes minority stake in Crypto.com with prediction market deal, to underwrite Oura IPO, reports say. Goldman lifts price target.

items.title: Robinhood Takes Equity Stake in Crypto.com, Taps Exchange to Power Prediction Markets
items.summary: The multi-year deal makes OG.com the infrastructure and clearing engine behind Robinhood's fastest-growing business.

items.title: Robinhood Partners with Crypto.com to Expand Prediction Markets

items.title: Robinhood Takes Stakes in Crypto.com, OG.com
items.summary: Robinhood will add OG.com prediction markets and take minority stakes in both OG and Crypto.com as it expands its event-contract business.

items.title: Robinhood Enters IPO Underwriting: Can IB Be the Next Growth Avenue?
items.summary: HOOD enters IPO underwriting with Oura. The move is expected to expand retail allocations, deepen issuer ties and add a new fee-based revenue stream.

items.title: Strategy Didn’t Touch Bitcoin Last Week After Making First Purchase Since June
items.summary: Strategy doesn’t sell or purchase any Bitcoin last week. The stock is falling as Bitcoin prices retreat.

items.title: Robinhood Strikes Prediction-Market, Equity Deal With OG.com
items.summary: Robinhood Markets Inc. will take equity stakes in Crypto.com and its prediction-markets platform spinoff OG.com as part of a multiyear agreement that will add another provider of event contracts to the brokerage’s predictions business.
